trap.label: had + pp
trap.wrong: Had firms did so, prices would be lower.
trap.right: Had firms done so, prices would be lower.
trap.why: Em português o particípio de “fazer” é feito/fizeram e o aluno mistura formas. Em inglês, depois de Had use o particípio: done.

mcq.q: “___ doctors to explain, patients would understand.”
A police statement of unproved crime:
Mixed: “If I had saved, I ___ rich now.”

fix.wrong: Were doctors explain, patients would understand.
fix.right: Were doctors to explain, patients would understand.

fix.wrong: Police assert he stole it, without proof.
fix.right: Police allege he stole it, without proof.

fix.wrong: If I would save, I would be rich.
fix.right: If I saved, I would be rich.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If firms had done so, prices would be lower.”
rewrite.answer: Had firms done so, prices would be lower.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If doctors were to explain, patients would understand.”
rewrite.answer: Were doctors to explain, patients would understand.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com assert: “The author firmly says it works.”
rewrite.answer: The author asserts that it works.
